shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- index.css ---\\n' && cat src/index.css && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- vite ---\\n' && cat vite.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg \"export .*TextField|export .*Button|export .*Checkbox|ThemeProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -20 && rg \"declare const ThemeProvider|interface TextFieldProps|type TextFieldProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null || true && rg \"TextField\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | head -30 && sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -30'

/bin/bash -lc 'sed -n 1,100p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && sed -n 1,100p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && sed -n 1,100p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/base.scss 2>/dev/null | head -50 || ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts | head -160 && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p\\n' | head -40 && rg \"onChange\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- package.json src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/index.css'
